// Moore FSM, positive edge triggered reset, inline state encoding
module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  in,
    output reg out
);
    reg [1:0] state, next_state;
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin next_state = 2'b00; out = 1'b0; end
            2'b01: begin next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b00; out = 1'b0; end
            2'b10: begin next_state = in ? 2'b11 : 2'b01; out = 1'b0; end
            2'b11: begin next_state = in ? 2'b00 : 2'b10; out = 1'b1; end
        endcase
    end
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
        else state <= next_state;
    end
endmodule

// Moore state machine, positive edge triggered asynchronous reset, 2-bit
// next state function, 1-bit output. Same as the reference design.
module TopModule(input clk, input areset, input in, output reg out);
  reg [1:0] state, next_state;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (areset) begin state <= 2'd0; end else begin state <= next_state; end
  end
  always @(*) begin
    case (state)
      2'd0: begin out = 1'b0; next_state = (in ? 2'd1 : 2'd0); end
      2'd1: begin out = 1'b0; next_state = (in ? 2'd2 : 2'd1); end
      2'd2: begin out = 1'b1; next_state = (in ? 2'd3 : 2'd2); end
      2'd3: begin out = 1'b0; next_state = (in ? 2'd0 : 2'd3); end
      default: next_state = 2'd0;
    endcase
  end
endmodule
